newsitem.title: GERMANY: European airlines group changes name.
newsitem.headline: European airlines group changes name.

text.p: The European Regional Airlines Association (ERA) said it has decided to change its name to the European Regions Airlines Association.
ERA president Dritz Feitl said the association decided at its Hanover annual general meeting to change its name later this year in recognition of the changing role of regional airlines.
"We are transgressing the boundaries between nationals and regionals and we feel the name 'regional' did not describe correctly what we do," he told a news conference.
The new name would emphasise the role of smaller airlines in reflecting and supporting economic development in European regions, he added.
Regional carriers such as Crossair, Eurowings and Tyrolean Airways are increasingly operating international routes in co-operation with or on behalf of large European carriers on cost grounds.
